proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr generic ability-modifier addend
proposed_widenings.justification: The main reduce-damage effect exists, but its amount grammar cannot express dice plus a non-spellcasting ability modifier.
proposed_widenings.evidence: reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is only legal when the wearer has a free hand, and the current equipment-gate vocabulary cannot encode that prerequisite.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have a free hand

proposed_widenings.name: catch_incoming_weapon_or_ammunition
proposed_widenings.justification: The current effect surface can reduce damage, but it cannot model the deterministic follow-on rider that lets the reactor catch the incoming projectile or thrown weapon on a full reduction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon

notes: Top-level fit is existing magic_item + triggered_reaction, so this is not structural. I left content/ untouched because encoding the main reaction without the Dex-mod amount and free-hand gate would be knowingly false.
